notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI has no zone-entry splash surface. Benilla's ZoneText.xml ships ZoneTextFrame (big zone name + PvP territory line on NEW_AREA), SubZoneTextFrame (26px subzone + FFA line), the FadingFrame fade kit, and AutoFollowStatus. In MSUI the supporting laws exist - FontObjectLaw carries ZoneTextFont(102, cream)/SubZoneTextFont(26) definitions and UiFrameFadeLaw is the transcribed fade state machine - but nothing consumes them: no splash renders on zone change; the only zone text drawn is the minimap header label (Program.Minimap.cs), a different surface.
